```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
va <- read.csv(if (file.exists("va_data.csv")) "va_data.csv" else "pages_epps_6356/va_data.csv")
latest <- va |> filter(is_latest == 1) |> select(series_id, fiscal_year, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = series_id, values_from = value) |> arrange(fiscal_year)
disc_gap <- va |> filter(series_id == "tot_discretionary_derived", vintage_lag == 0, latest_is_final == 1, fiscal_year >= 2010)
cross <- latest |> filter(tot_mandatory > tot_va - tot_mandatory) |> slice(1)
share <- function(i) (latest$tot_va[i] - latest$tot_mandatory[i]) / latest$tot_va[i]
pct <- function(x) paste0(round(100 * x), "%")
```

# Overview

## Row {height="270px"}

::: {.card .va-hero}
```{=html}
<div class="va-hero-body">
<div class="va-kicker">Veterans Affairs Budget Analysis</div>
<div class="va-title">VA Budget</div>
<div class="va-sub"><span class="st">&#9733; &#9733;</span>FY2008 &ndash; FY2026<span class="st">&#9733; &#9733;</span></div>
<div class="va-ribbon">Requested vs. enacted &middot; Discretionary vs. mandatory</div>
</div>
```
:::

## Row

::: {.card title="About this dashboard"}
The **executive branch** (the President's budget, prepared by VA) asks Congress for money account by account, and the **legislative branch** decides what to enact. Each year VA publishes a five-volume Congressional Budget Submission, and each edition reports the same fiscal year as a **request**, then as **enacted or estimated**, and finally as **enacted or actual**.

This dashboard links those editions for FY2008–FY2026 and answers two questions:

- **RQ1 · Requested vs. enacted.** How far are VA's requests from what Congress enacts, does the gap change by year, and is it larger for some accounts (medical care, IT, construction)?
- **RQ2 · Discretionary vs. mandatory.** When did mandatory funding overtake discretionary funding, which programs drove it, and is the discretionary share shrinking mostly because mandatory grows faster?
- **Map · Where VA spends.** In which states do mandatory benefits (compensation and pension) make up most of VA spending, and how has that changed from FY2015 to FY2023? This page uses VA's *Geographic Distribution of VA Expenditures* (GDX) by state.

Use the controls on the left of each page. The cards, charts and text update together. The first load takes a few seconds while R starts in your browser.
:::

::: {.card title="How to read the numbers"}
- **Request** = value printed in the edition for its own fiscal year. **Enacted** = value in the latest edition that reports that year.
- **Gap** = (enacted − requested) ÷ requested. A positive gap means more was provided than requested.
- **Discretionary** = total VA funding − mandatory funding (includes MCCF collections and the Transformational Fund).
- Budget authority in nominal **dollars**; not outlays.
- Source: VA Congressional Budget Submissions, FY2008–FY2027, transcribed by the team.
:::

# RQ1 · Requested vs. enacted

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 1150
## file: app.R
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- data
va <- read.csv("va_data.csv")
FY_MIN <- 2008; FY_MAX <- 2026

gaps_all <- va |>
  filter(vintage_lag == 0, latest_is_final == 1, !is.na(gap_pct_of_request))

accts <- c(
  acct_medical_services = "Medical Services", acct_medical_community_care = "Medical Community Care",
  acct_medical_support_compliance = "Medical Support & Compliance", acct_medical_facilities = "Medical Facilities",
  acct_medical_research = "Medical & Prosthetic Research", acct_it_systems = "IT Systems",
  acct_ehrm = "EHR Modernization", acct_construction_major = "Construction, Major",
  acct_construction_minor = "Construction, Minor", acct_grants_state_ext_care = "Grants, State Extended Care",
  acct_goe_vba = "General Operating Exp., VBA", acct_general_admin = "General Administration",
  acct_nca = "National Cemetery Admin.", acct_oig = "Inspector General")
grp_of <- c(
  acct_medical_services = "Medical care", acct_medical_community_care = "Medical care",
  acct_medical_support_compliance = "Medical care", acct_medical_facilities = "Medical care",
  acct_medical_research = "Other", acct_it_systems = "IT", acct_ehrm = "IT",
  acct_construction_major = "Construction", acct_construction_minor = "Construction",
  acct_grants_state_ext_care = "Construction", acct_goe_vba = "Other", acct_general_admin = "Other",
  acct_nca = "Other", acct_oig = "Other")
GROUPS <- c("Medical care", "IT", "Construction", "Other")

acct_gaps_all <- gaps_all |>
  filter(series_id %in% names(accts)) |>
  mutate(account = unname(accts[series_id]),
         group   = factor(unname(grp_of[series_id]), levels = GROUPS))

FTYPE <- c("Discretionary" = "tot_discretionary_derived", "Mandatory" = "tot_mandatory", "Total VA" = "tot_va")
admin_of <- function(fy) case_when(fy <= 2009 ~ "Bush", fy <= 2017 ~ "Obama", fy <= 2021 ~ "Trump I",
                                   fy <= 2025 ~ "Biden", TRUE ~ "Trump II")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- look
pal <- c(blue = "#0A3161", purple = "#B31942", sky = "#6C9BD2", yellow = "#D4A62A",
         orange = "#6E7B3E", pink = "#B31942", mint = "#A9B3C1", grey = "#B8C0CC")
grp_cols <- c("Medical care" = pal[["blue"]], IT = pal[["pink"]], Construction = pal[["orange"]], Other = pal[["grey"]])
ink <- "#13233F"; muted <- "#5A6578"
theme_va <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8.5) +
    theme(text = element_text(colour = ink),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = muted),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = muted),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5), legend.title = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left",
          strip.text = element_text(size = 8.5, face = "bold", colour = ink),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(8, 14, 8, 8))
}
leg_in <- function(x, y, key = 0.72, just = c(x, y)) {
  th <- theme(legend.direction = "vertical", legend.justification = just,
              legend.key.size = unit(key, "lines"),
              legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.88), colour = NA),
              legend.margin = margin(3, 6, 3, 6))
  if (utils::packageVersion("ggplot2") >= "3.5.0") th + theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(x, y))
  else th + theme(legend.position = c(x, y))
}
pct  <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "%")
spct <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(ifelse(x > 0, "+", ""), formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "%")
mn   <- function(x) paste0("$", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","), "M")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- UI
plot_card <- function(plot_id, text_id, height = "360px") {
  card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header(textOutput(paste0(plot_id, "_ttl"), inline = TRUE)),
       plotOutput(plot_id, height = height),
       card_footer(uiOutput(text_id), div(class = "src", "Source: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Congressional Budget Submissions (Vols. I–V), FY2008–FY2027 editions; compiled by the authors. Nominal budget authority.")))
}

ui <- page_sidebar(
  fillable = FALSE,
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5, primary = pal[["blue"]], base_font = font_google("Source Sans 3", local = FALSE), heading_font = font_google("Oswald", local = FALSE), fg = ink, bg = "#ffffff"),
  sidebar = sidebar(
    width = 290,
    sliderInput("years", "Fiscal years", min = FY_MIN, max = FY_MAX, value = c(FY_MIN, FY_MAX), step = 1, sep = ""),
    conditionalPanel("input.tab == 'Request vs. enacted' || input.tab == 'Gap by year'",
      radioButtons("ftype", "Funding type", choices = names(FTYPE), selected = "Discretionary")),
    conditionalPanel("input.tab != 'Request vs. enacted' && input.tab != 'Gap by year'",
      checkboxGroupInput("groups", "Account groups", choices = GROUPS, selected = GROUPS)),
    conditionalPanel("input.tab == 'By account'",
      radioButtons("measure", "Compare accounts by",
                   choices = c("Median absolute gap" = "median_abs", "Mean signed gap" = "mean_signed",
                               "Share of years changed (>1%)" = "changed"),
                   selected = "median_abs")),
    helpText("Gap = (enacted − requested) ÷ requested. Request = the edition for that fiscal year; enacted = the latest edition.")
  ),
  tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
    .bslib-value-box { min-height: 0 !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .card-body { padding: .3rem .4rem !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-area { padding: .35rem .8rem !important; gap: 0 !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-title { font-size: .85rem !important; margin-bottom: .1rem !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-value { font-size: 1.55rem !important; line-height: 1.15 !important; margin-bottom: .1rem !important; }
    .bslib-sidebar-layout > .sidebar { font-size: .9rem; }
    .bslib-sidebar-layout > .sidebar .control-label, .bslib-sidebar-layout > .sidebar .form-label { font-size: .9rem; }
    .vb-row { margin-bottom: 1.4rem !important; }
    .vb-row + * { margin-top: 0 !important; }
    .bslib-value-box { border: 0 !important; border-top: 4px solid #B31942 !important; border-radius: 6px !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-title { font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-title::before { content: '\\2605  '; color: #B31942; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-value { font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; font-weight: 600 !important; letter-spacing: .02em; }
    .card-header { font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #0A1F44; border-bottom: 2px solid #B31942; }
    .card-footer .src { font-size: .75rem; color: #5A6578; margin-top: .35rem; border-top: 1px solid #E3E7EC; padding-top: .3rem; }
    .nav-underline .nav-link, .nav-tabs .nav-link { font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; }
    .nav-underline .nav-link.active { color: #B31942 !important; border-bottom-color: #B31942 !important; }
    .bslib-value-box p { font-size: .8rem !important; margin: 0 !important; opacity: .9; }
  "))),
  layout_columns(
    fill = FALSE, class = "vb-row",
    value_box(title = "Largest gap in the window", value = textOutput("vb_max"), showcase = NULL,
              theme = value_box_theme(bg = "#0A1F44", fg = "white"), p(textOutput("vb_max_note"))),
    value_box(title = "Median gap, selected accounts", value = textOutput("vb_med"),
              theme = value_box_theme(bg = "#0A1F44", fg = "white"), p(textOutput("vb_med_note"))),
    value_box(title = "Most revised account", value = textOutput("vb_top"),
              theme = value_box_theme(bg = "#0A1F44", fg = "white"), p(textOutput("vb_top_note")))
  ),
  navset_card_underline(
    id = "tab",
    nav_panel("Request vs. enacted", plot_card("p_dumbbell", "t_dumbbell", "600px")),
    nav_panel("Gap by year",         plot_card("p_diverging", "t_diverging")),
    nav_panel("By account",          plot_card("p_accounts", "t_accounts")),
    nav_panel("Account × year",      plot_card("p_heatmap", "t_heatmap", "440px")),
    nav_panel("How often & which way", plot_card("p_bubbles", "t_bubbles", "440px")),
    nav_panel("All account-years",   plot_card("p_curve", "t_curve"))
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- server
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  yr  <- reactive(input$years)
  tot <- reactive({
    gaps_all |> filter(series_id == FTYPE[[input$ftype]], between(fiscal_year, yr()[1], yr()[2]))
  })
  ag <- reactive({
    validate(need(length(input$groups) > 0, "Select at least one account group."))
    acct_gaps_all |> filter(group %in% input$groups, between(fiscal_year, yr()[1], yr()[2]))
  })
  acct_sum <- reactive({
    ag() |>
      group_by(account, group) |>
      summarise(years = n(), median_abs = median(abs(gap_pct_of_request)),
                mean_signed = mean(gap_pct_of_request), changed = mean(abs(gap_pct_of_request) > 0.01),
                med_signed = median(gap_pct_of_request), size = mean(value_latest) / 1000, .groups = "drop")
  })


  # ---- message titles (update with the filters)
  output$p_dumbbell_ttl <- renderText({
    d <- tot(); k <- sum(abs(d$gap_pct_of_request) <= 0.025)
    paste0(input$ftype, " funding: Congress enacted within ±2.5% of the request in ", k, " of ", nrow(d), " years")
  })
  output$p_diverging_ttl <- renderText({
    d <- tot(); up <- sum(d$gap_pct_of_request > 0.0005); dn <- sum(d$gap_pct_of_request < -0.0005)
    paste0("Congress gave more than requested in ", up, " years and less in ", dn,
           " (average gap ", spct(mean(d$gap_pct_of_request)), ")")
  })
  output$p_accounts_ttl <- renderText({
    a <- acct_sum(); a$val <- a[[input$measure]]
    hi <- a$account[which.max(a$val)]; lo <- a$account[which.min(a$val)]
    switch(input$measure,
      median_abs  = paste0(hi, " departs most from the request; ", lo, " the least"),
      mean_signed = paste0(hi, " gets the most extra money on average; ", lo, " is cut the most"),
      changed     = paste0(hi, " is changed most often; ", lo, " the least"))
  })
  output$p_heatmap_ttl <- renderText({
    g <- ag() |> group_by(group) |> summarise(big = sum(abs(gap_pct_of_request) > 0.10), .groups = "drop") |> arrange(desc(big))
    if (sum(g$big) == 0) "No account-year departs from the request by more than 10%" else
      paste0(g$group[1], " accounts hold ", g$big[1], " of the ", sum(g$big), " account-years that miss the request by more than 10%")
  })
  output$p_bubbles_ttl <- renderText({
    b <- acct_sum(); rare <- sum(b$changed < 0.5); cut <- sum(b$changed >= 0.5 & b$med_signed < -0.005)
    paste0(rare, " of ", nrow(b), " accounts are rarely changed; ", cut, " are often changed and usually cut")
  })
  output$p_curve_ttl <- renderText({
    q <- quantile(abs(ag()$gap_pct_of_request), c(.5, .9))
    paste0("Half of all account-years miss the request by less than ", pct(q[1]), "; the top 10% miss by more than ", pct(q[2], 0))
  })

  # ---- value boxes
  output$vb_max <- renderText({ d <- tot(); i <- which.max(abs(d$gap_pct_of_request)); spct(d$gap_pct_of_request[i]) })
  output$vb_max_note <- renderText({ d <- tot(); i <- which.max(abs(d$gap_pct_of_request))
    paste0(input$ftype, ", FY", d$fiscal_year[i]) })
  output$vb_med <- renderText(pct(median(abs(ag()$gap_pct_of_request))))
  output$vb_med_note <- renderText(paste0(nrow(ag()), " account-years, FY", yr()[1], "–FY", yr()[2]))
  output$vb_top <- renderText({ a <- acct_sum() |> slice_max(median_abs, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE); a$account })
  output$vb_top_note <- renderText({ a <- acct_sum() |> slice_max(median_abs, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
    paste0("median gap ", pct(a$median_abs)) })

  # ---- dumbbell
  output$p_dumbbell <- renderPlot({
    d <- tot() |>
      transmute(fiscal_year, admin = factor(admin_of(fiscal_year), levels = c("Bush", "Obama", "Trump I", "Biden", "Trump II")),
                Requested = value_request / 1000, Enacted = value_latest / 1000,
                change = round(Enacted - Requested, 1) + 0,
                fy = factor(fiscal_year, levels = rev(sort(unique(fiscal_year)))))
    lo <- floor(min(d$Requested, d$Enacted) / 10) * 10; hi <- ceiling(max(d$Requested, d$Enacted) / 10) * 10
    chg <- hi + (hi - lo) * 0.16
    ggplot(d, aes(y = fy)) +
      geom_segment(aes(x = lo, xend = hi, yend = fy), colour = "#EEF0F3", linewidth = 5, lineend = "round") +
      geom_segment(aes(x = Requested, xend = Enacted, yend = fy), colour = "#7D8796", linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_point(aes(x = Requested), colour = pal[["yellow"]], size = 4.6) +
      geom_point(aes(x = Enacted), colour = pal[["blue"]], size = 4.6) +
      geom_text(aes(x = chg, label = sprintf("%+.1f", change)), hjust = 1, size = 3, colour = ink) +
      geom_text(data = d |> filter(fiscal_year == min(fiscal_year)), aes(x = chg, label = "Change ($B)"),
                hjust = 1, vjust = -1.4, size = 3, fontface = "bold", colour = ink) +
      facet_grid(admin ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
      scale_x_continuous(position = "top", limits = c(lo, chg), breaks = pretty(c(lo, hi), 4)[pretty(c(lo, hi), 4) <= hi],
                         labels = label_dollar(suffix = "B"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      labs(x = "Budget authority ($ billions)", y = "Fiscal year", subtitle = "Gold = requested · navy = enacted") +
      theme_va() +
      theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "#D5DAE1", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4),
            strip.placement = "outside",
            strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, face = "plain", colour = muted),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = muted, size = 8.5, margin = margin(b = 18)))
  }, res = 96)
  output$t_dumbbell <- renderUI({
    d <- tot(); big <- d |> filter(abs(gap_pct_of_request) > 0.025)
    p(HTML(paste0("For <b>", tolower(input$ftype), "</b> funding in FY", yr()[1], "–FY", yr()[2],
      ", the enacted total stayed within ±2.5% of the request in <b>", sum(abs(d$gap_pct_of_request) <= 0.025),
      " of ", nrow(d), "</b> years.",
      if (nrow(big)) paste0(" Larger gaps: ", paste0("FY", big$fiscal_year, " (", spct(big$gap_pct_of_request), ")", collapse = ", "), ".") else "",
      if (input$ftype != "Discretionary") " Mandatory gaps reflect re-estimates of benefit costs, not congressional cuts." else "")))
  })

  # ---- gap by year
  output$p_diverging <- renderPlot({
    d <- tot() |> mutate(dir = if_else(gap_pct_of_request >= 0, "Enacted above request", "Enacted below request"))
    ggplot(d, aes(fiscal_year, gap_pct_of_request, fill = dir)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#9AA5B4") +
      geom_col(width = 0.72) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Enacted above request" = pal[["blue"]], "Enacted below request" = pal[["pink"]])) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(6)) +
      labs(x = "Fiscal year", y = "Gap (% of request)") + theme_va() +
      leg_in(0.995, 1.05 / 1.10, just = c(1, 1)) + theme(legend.margin = margin(0, 4, 3, 6))
  }, res = 96)
  output$t_diverging <- renderUI({
    d <- tot()
    p(HTML(paste0("Average gap ", spct(mean(d$gap_pct_of_request)), " · enacted above the request in <b>",
      sum(d$gap_pct_of_request > 0.0005), "</b> years, below in <b>", sum(d$gap_pct_of_request < -0.0005), "</b>.",
      " Largest: FY", d$fiscal_year[which.max(abs(d$gap_pct_of_request))], " (",
      spct(d$gap_pct_of_request[which.max(abs(d$gap_pct_of_request))]), ").")))
  })

  # ---- by account
  m_lab <- c(median_abs = "Median absolute gap (% of request)", mean_signed = "Mean signed gap (% of request)", changed = "Years changed by more than 1% (% of years)")
  output$p_accounts <- renderPlot({
    a <- acct_sum(); a$val <- a[[input$measure]]
    ggplot(a, aes(val, reorder(account, val), fill = group)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7) +
      geom_text(aes(label = if (input$measure == "mean_signed") spct(val) else pct(val),
                    hjust = ifelse(val >= 0, -0.12, 1.12)), size = 3, colour = ink) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = grp_cols) +
      scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.18))) +
      labs(x = m_lab[[input$measure]], y = "Account") + theme_va() +
      theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) + leg_in(0.99, 0.02)
  }, res = 96)
  output$t_accounts <- renderUI({
    g <- ag() |> group_by(group) |> summarise(m = median(abs(gap_pct_of_request)), .groups = "drop") |> arrange(m)
    p(HTML(paste0("Median absolute gap by group: ",
      paste0("<b>", g$group, "</b> ", pct(g$m), collapse = " · "),
      ". The two branches agree most on the accounts at the bottom of the chart (small gaps) and disagree most on those at the top.")))
  })

  # ---- heatmap
  output$p_heatmap <- renderPlot({
    a <- ag(); ord <- acct_sum() |> arrange(median_abs) |> pull(account); lim <- 0.25
    ggplot(a, aes(fiscal_year, factor(account, levels = ord), fill = pmax(pmin(gap_pct_of_request, lim), -lim))) +
      geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = pal[["pink"]], mid = "#F7F7F5", high = pal[["blue"]], midpoint = 0,
                           limits = c(-lim, lim), labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(6), expand = c(0, 0)) +
      labs(x = "Fiscal year", y = "Account", fill = "Gap (% of request)") + theme_va() +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = "center",
            legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"), legend.title = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = muted, vjust = 0.8))
  }, res = 96)
  output$t_heatmap <- renderUI({
    a <- ag(); top <- a |> slice_max(abs(gap_pct_of_request), n = 3, with_ties = FALSE)
    p(HTML(paste0("Navy = Congress enacted more than requested, red = less (capped at ±25%). Biggest departures in the selection: ",
      paste0("<b>", top$account, "</b> FY", top$fiscal_year, " (", spct(top$gap_pct_of_request, 0), ")", collapse = "; "), ".")))
  })

  # ---- bubbles
  output$p_bubbles <- renderPlot({
    b <- acct_sum() |> mutate(y = pmax(pmin(med_signed, 0.15), -0.15))
    p <- ggplot(b, aes(changed, y)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#9AA5B4") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#9AA5B4") +
      annotate("text", x = 0.99, y = 0.15, label = "Often changed,\nusually raised", hjust = 1, vjust = 1, fontface = "italic", size = 2.8, colour = muted) +
      annotate("text", x = 0.99, y = -0.15, label = "Often changed,\nusually cut", hjust = 1, vjust = 0, fontface = "italic", size = 2.8, colour = muted) +
      annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.15, label = "Rarely changed", hjust = 0, vjust = 1, fontface = "italic", size = 2.8, colour = muted) +
      geom_point(aes(size = size, colour = group, alpha = group == "Medical care")) +
      scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 0.45, `FALSE` = 0.85), guide = "none") +
      scale_colour_manual(values = grp_cols) +
      scale_size_area(max_size = 24, guide = "none") +
      scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1), limits = c(-0.155, 0.155)) +
      guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 6))) +
      labs(x = "Years changed by more than 1% (% of years)", y = "Median gap (% of request)") + theme_va()
    if (requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
      p + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = account), size = 2.3, colour = ink, box.padding = 0.35, point.size = NA,
                                   segment.colour = muted, segment.size = 0.3,
                                   min.segment.length = 0.3, seed = 7, max.overlaps = Inf)
    } else p + geom_text(aes(label = account), size = 2.3, colour = ink, vjust = -1.2)
  }, res = 96)
  output$t_bubbles <- renderUI({
    b <- acct_sum()
    rare <- b |> filter(changed < 0.5) |> pull(account); cut <- b |> filter(changed >= 0.5, med_signed < -0.005) |> pull(account)
    p(HTML(paste0("Bubble size = average enacted funding. <b>Rarely changed:</b> ", if (length(rare)) paste(rare, collapse = ", ") else "none",
      ". <b>Often changed and usually cut:</b> ", if (length(cut)) paste(cut, collapse = ", ") else "none", ".")))
  })

  # ---- ranked curve
  output$p_curve <- renderPlot({
    cap <- 0.6
    cd <- ag() |> mutate(abs_gap = abs(gap_pct_of_request)) |> arrange(abs_gap) |>
      mutate(pctile = (row_number() - 0.5) / n(), y = pmin(abs_gap, cap))
    qs <- quantile(cd$abs_gap, c(.25, .5, .75))
    ggplot(cd, aes(pctile, y)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(.25, .5, .75), linetype = "dotted", colour = "#9AA5B4") +
      annotate("text", x = c(.25, .5, .75), y = cap * 1.08, label = pct(qs), fontface = "italic", size = 3, colour = ink) +
      geom_line(colour = ink, linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_segment(aes(x = pctile, xend = pctile, y = -0.05, yend = -0.015, colour = group), linewidth = 1) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = grp_cols) +
      guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 2.4))) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(.25, .5, .75), labels = c("25th", "50th", "75th"), limits = c(0, 1)) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1), limits = c(-0.055, cap * 1.12), breaks = seq(0, cap, 0.2)) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      labs(x = "Account-years ranked by gap (percentile)", y = "Absolute gap (% of request, capped at 60%)") + theme_va() + leg_in(0.01, 0.63, just = c(0, 0.5))
  }, res = 96)
  output$t_curve <- renderUI({
    cd <- ag(); qs <- quantile(abs(cd$gap_pct_of_request), c(.25, .5, .75))
    top <- cd |> filter(abs(gap_pct_of_request) >= qs[3]) |> count(group, sort = TRUE)
    p(HTML(paste0("Quartiles of the gap: <b>", pct(qs[1]), "</b>, <b>", pct(qs[2]), "</b> and <b>", pct(qs[3]),
      "</b>. In the top quarter: ", paste0(top$group, " (", top$n, ")", collapse = ", "),
      ". Ticks on the baseline show where each group falls.")))
  })
}
```

# RQ2 · Discretionary vs. mandatory

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 1050
## file: app.R
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- data
va <- read.csv("va_data.csv")
FY_MIN <- 2008; FY_MAX <- 2026

latest <- va |>
  filter(is_latest == 1) |>
  select(series_id, fiscal_year, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = series_id, values_from = value) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

r2_all <- latest |>
  transmute(fiscal_year,
            total = tot_va, mandatory = tot_mandatory, discretionary = tot_va - tot_mandatory,
            cp = mand_comp_pension, readj = mand_readjustment, tef = coalesce(tef_total, 0),
            other = mandatory - cp - readj - tef)

short <- c("Compensation & Pensions" = "C&P", "Toxic Exposures Fund" = "TEF",
           "Readjustment benefits" = "Readjustment", "Other mandatory" = "Other")
PROGS <- c("Compensation & Pensions" = "cp", "Toxic Exposures Fund" = "tef",
           "Readjustment benefits" = "readj", "Other mandatory" = "other")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- look
pal <- c(blue = "#0A3161", purple = "#B31942", sky = "#6C9BD2", yellow = "#D4A62A",
         orange = "#6E7B3E", pink = "#B31942", mint = "#A9B3C1", grey = "#B8C0CC")
prog_cols <- c("Compensation & Pensions" = pal[["purple"]], "Toxic Exposures Fund" = pal[["sky"]],
               "Readjustment benefits" = pal[["yellow"]], "Other mandatory" = pal[["grey"]])
ink <- "#13233F"; muted <- "#5A6578"
theme_va <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8.5) +
    theme(text = element_text(colour = ink),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = muted),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = muted),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5), legend.title = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(8, 14, 8, 8))
}
bn  <- function(x, d = 1) paste0("$", formatC(x / 1000, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ","), "B")
pct <- function(x, d = 0) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "%")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- UI
plot_card <- function(plot_id, text_id, height = "360px") {
  card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header(textOutput(paste0(plot_id, "_ttl"), inline = TRUE)),
       plotOutput(plot_id, height = height),
       card_footer(uiOutput(text_id), div(class = "src", "Source: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Congressional Budget Submissions (Vols. I–V), FY2008–FY2027 editions; compiled by the authors. Nominal budget authority.")))
}

ui <- page_sidebar(
  fillable = FALSE,
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5, primary = pal[["blue"]], base_font = font_google("Source Sans 3", local = FALSE), heading_font = font_google("Oswald", local = FALSE), fg = ink, bg = "#ffffff"),
  sidebar = sidebar(
    width = 290,
    sliderInput("years", "Fiscal years", min = FY_MIN, max = FY_MAX, value = c(FY_MIN, FY_MAX), step = 1, sep = ""),
    conditionalPanel("input.tab == 'Mandatory vs. discretionary' || input.tab == 'Mandatory programs'",
      radioButtons("units", "Show funding as", choices = c("$ billions", "% of total VA funding"), selected = "$ billions")),
    conditionalPanel("input.tab == 'Mandatory programs'",
      checkboxGroupInput("progs", "Mandatory programs", choices = names(PROGS), selected = names(PROGS))),
    helpText("Final (enacted) budget authority, nominal dollars. Discretionary = total VA − mandatory.")
  ),
  tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
    .bslib-value-box { min-height: 0 !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .card-body { padding: .3rem .4rem !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-area { padding: .35rem .8rem !important; gap: 0 !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-title { font-size: .85rem !important; margin-bottom: .1rem !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-value { font-size: 1.55rem !important; line-height: 1.15 !important; margin-bottom: .1rem !important; }
    .bslib-sidebar-layout > .sidebar { font-size: .9rem; }
    .bslib-sidebar-layout > .sidebar .control-label, .bslib-sidebar-layout > .sidebar .form-label { font-size: .9rem; }
    .vb-row { margin-bottom: 1.4rem !important; }
    .vb-row + * { margin-top: 0 !important; }
    .bslib-value-box { border: 0 !important; border-top: 4px solid #B31942 !important; border-radius: 6px !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-title { font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-title::before { content: '\\2605  '; color: #B31942; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-value { font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; font-weight: 600 !important; letter-spacing: .02em; }
    .card-header { font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #0A1F44; border-bottom: 2px solid #B31942; }
    .card-footer .src { font-size: .75rem; color: #5A6578; margin-top: .35rem; border-top: 1px solid #E3E7EC; padding-top: .3rem; }
    .nav-underline .nav-link, .nav-tabs .nav-link { font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; }
    .nav-underline .nav-link.active { color: #B31942 !important; border-bottom-color: #B31942 !important; }
    .bslib-value-box p { font-size: .8rem !important; margin: 0 !important; opacity: .9; }
  "))),
  layout_columns(
    fill = FALSE, class = "vb-row",
    value_box(title = "Mandatory passed discretionary", value = textOutput("vb_cross"),
              theme = value_box_theme(bg = "#0A1F44", fg = "white"), p(textOutput("vb_cross_note"))),
    value_box(title = "Mandatory growth in the window", value = textOutput("vb_growth"),
              theme = value_box_theme(bg = "#0A1F44", fg = "white"), p(textOutput("vb_growth_note"))),
    value_box(title = "Discretionary share of VA funding", value = textOutput("vb_share"),
              theme = value_box_theme(bg = "#0A1F44", fg = "white"), p(textOutput("vb_share_note")))
  ),
  navset_card_underline(
    id = "tab",
    nav_panel("Mandatory vs. discretionary", plot_card("p_lines", "t_lines")),
    nav_panel("Mandatory programs",          plot_card("p_area", "t_area")),
    nav_panel("What drove the growth",
      card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header(textOutput("p_contrib_ttl", inline = TRUE)),
           plotOutput("p_contrib", height = "230px"),
           plotOutput("p_waffle", height = "230px"),
           card_footer(uiOutput("t_contrib"), div(class = "src", "Source: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Congressional Budget Submissions (Vols. I–V), FY2008–FY2027 editions; compiled by the authors. Nominal budget authority.")))),
    nav_panel("Shrinking share?",            plot_card("p_share", "t_share"))
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- server
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  r2 <- reactive({
    validate(need(input$years[2] > input$years[1], "Choose a window of at least two years."))
    r2_all |> filter(between(fiscal_year, input$years[1], input$years[2]))
  })
  first <- reactive(r2() |> slice(1)); last <- reactive(r2() |> slice(n()))
  growth <- reactive({
    tibble(program = names(PROGS),
           change = vapply(PROGS, function(v) last()[[v]] - first()[[v]], numeric(1))) |>
      mutate(share = change / sum(change))
  })

  # ---- value boxes
  cross <- reactive({ x <- r2() |> filter(mandatory > discretionary); if (nrow(x)) x$fiscal_year[1] else NA })
  output$vb_cross <- renderText(if (is.na(cross())) "Not in window" else paste0("FY", cross()))
  output$vb_cross_note <- renderText({
    if (is.na(cross())) "mandatory stays below discretionary"
    else if (cross() == input$years[1]) "already ahead at the start of the window"
    else "first year mandatory > discretionary" })
  output$vb_growth <- renderText(paste0("+", bn(last()$mandatory - first()$mandatory)))
  output$vb_growth_note <- renderText(paste0(formatC(last()$mandatory / first()$mandatory, format = "f", digits = 1),
                                             "× from FY", input$years[1], " to FY", input$years[2]))
  output$vb_share <- renderText(paste0(pct(first()$discretionary / first()$total), " → ", pct(last()$discretionary / last()$total)))
  output$vb_share_note <- renderText(paste0("FY", input$years[1], " to FY", input$years[2]))


  # ---- message titles (update with the filters)
  output$p_lines_ttl <- renderText({
    c10 <- cross()
    if (is.na(c10)) "Mandatory funding stays below discretionary funding in this window"
    else if (c10 == input$years[1]) paste0("Mandatory funding is already larger than discretionary in FY", c10)
    else paste0("Mandatory funding overtook discretionary funding in FY", c10)
  })
  output$p_area_ttl <- renderText({
    req(length(input$progs) > 0)
    l <- last(); tot <- l$cp + l$tef + l$readj + l$other
    v <- vapply(PROGS[input$progs], function(k) l[[k]], numeric(1)); top <- names(v)[which.max(v)]
    paste0(top, " makes up ", pct(max(v) / tot), " of mandatory funding in FY", input$years[2])
  })
  output$p_contrib_ttl <- renderText({
    g <- growth() |> arrange(desc(change))
    paste0(g$program[1], " accounts for $", round(100 * g$share[1]), " of every $100 added to mandatory funding")
  })
  output$p_share_ttl <- renderText({
    f <- first(); l <- last(); gm <- l$mandatory / f$mandatory; gd <- l$discretionary / f$discretionary
    s0 <- pct(f$discretionary / f$total); s1 <- pct(l$discretionary / l$total)
    if (gm > gd) paste0("Discretionary share fell from ", s0, " to ", s1, " because mandatory grew faster (",
                        formatC(gm, format = "f", digits = 1), "× vs. ", formatC(gd, format = "f", digits = 1), "×)")
    else paste0("Discretionary share moved from ", s0, " to ", s1, "; mandatory did not outgrow discretionary")
  })

  # ---- lines
  output$p_lines <- renderPlot({
    share <- input$units != "$ billions"
    d <- r2() |> select(fiscal_year, Mandatory = mandatory, Discretionary = discretionary, total) |>
      pivot_longer(c(Mandatory, Discretionary)) |>
      mutate(y = if (share) value / total else value / 1000)
    ggplot(d, aes(fiscal_year, y, colour = name)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.4) + geom_point(size = 2.6) +
      geom_text(data = d |> filter(fiscal_year == max(fiscal_year)), aes(label = name),
                hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.3, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(Mandatory = pal[["purple"]], Discretionary = pal[["blue"]]), guide = "none") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = if (share) label_percent(accuracy = 1) else label_dollar(suffix = "B"), limits = c(0, NA)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(6), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.2))) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      labs(x = "Fiscal year", y = if (share) "Share of total VA funding (%)" else "Budget authority ($ billions)") + theme_va()
  }, res = 96)
  output$t_lines <- renderUI({
    d <- r2(); c10 <- cross()
    txt <- if (is.na(c10)) "In this window, mandatory funding never exceeds discretionary." else
      if (c10 == input$years[1]) paste0("Mandatory funding is already larger than discretionary in FY", c10, ".") else {
        a <- d |> filter(fiscal_year %in% c(c10 - 1, c10))
        paste0("Mandatory funding overtakes discretionary in <b>FY", c10, "</b>, rising from ", bn(a$mandatory[1]), " to ",
               bn(a$mandatory[2]), "; ", bn(a$cp[2] - a$cp[1]), " of that jump is Compensation & Pensions.") }
    p(HTML(paste0(txt, " By FY", input$years[2], " mandatory is ", bn(last()$mandatory), " and discretionary ",
                  bn(last()$discretionary), ".")))
  })

  # ---- stacked area + end-year bar
  output$p_area <- renderPlot({
    validate(need(length(input$progs) > 0, "Select at least one program."))
    share <- input$units != "$ billions"
    sel <- names(PROGS)[names(PROGS) %in% input$progs]
    d <- r2() |> select(fiscal_year, total, all_of(unname(PROGS[sel]))) |>
      pivot_longer(-c(fiscal_year, total), names_to = "v") |>
      mutate(program = factor(names(PROGS)[match(v, PROGS)], levels = rev(names(PROGS))),
             y = if (share) value / total else value / 1000)
    fy_end <- max(d$fiscal_year); span <- max(diff(range(d$fiscal_year)), 1)
    lab <- d |> filter(fiscal_year == fy_end) |> arrange(desc(program)) |>
      mutate(top = cumsum(y), mid = top - y / 2, tot = sum(y), inside = y >= 0.3 * tot)
    lx <- fy_end - span * 0.17
    out <- lab |> filter(!inside) |> arrange(desc(mid)) |>
      mutate(ly = tot * (1.12 - 0.11 * (row_number() - 1)))
    ins <- lab |> filter(inside)
    ggplot(d, aes(fiscal_year, y, fill = program)) +
      geom_area(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_segment(data = out, aes(x = lx + span * 0.01, xend = fy_end - span * 0.005, y = ly, yend = mid),
                   inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = muted, linewidth = 0.35) +
      geom_point(data = out, aes(x = fy_end - span * 0.005, y = mid), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = muted, size = 0.9) +
      geom_text(data = out, aes(x = lx, y = ly, label = program, colour = program), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                hjust = 1, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
      geom_text(data = ins, aes(x = fy_end - span * 0.04, y = mid, label = program), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                hjust = 1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", colour = "white") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = prog_cols, breaks = names(PROGS), guide = "none") +
      scale_colour_manual(values = prog_cols, guide = "none") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = if (share) label_percent(accuracy = 1) else label_dollar(suffix = "B"),
                         expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(6), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.01))) +
      labs(x = "Fiscal year", y = if (share) "Share of total VA funding (%)" else "Budget authority ($ billions)") + theme_va()
  }, res = 96)
  output$t_area <- renderUI({
    l <- last(); tot <- l$cp + l$tef + l$readj + l$other
    p(HTML(paste0("In FY", input$years[2], ", mandatory funding of ", bn(l$mandatory), " splits into ",
      "<b>Compensation & Pensions</b> ", bn(l$cp), " (", pct(l$cp / tot), "), ",
      "<b>Toxic Exposures Fund</b> ", bn(l$tef), " (", pct(l$tef / tot), "), ",
      "<b>Readjustment</b> ", bn(l$readj), " (", pct(l$readj / tot), ") and other programs ", bn(l$other), ".")))
  })

  # ---- contribution: columns + waffle
  output$p_contrib <- renderPlot({
    g <- growth() |> arrange(desc(change)) |> mutate(program = factor(program, levels = program), rank = row_number())
    p1 <- ggplot(g, aes(rank, change / 1000, fill = program)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#9AA5B4") +
      geom_text(aes(label = formatC(change / 1000, format = "f", digits = 1),
                    vjust = ifelse(change >= 0, -0.4, 1.3)), size = 3, colour = ink, fontface = "bold") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = prog_cols, guide = "none") +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = g$rank, labels = short[as.character(g$program)]) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = label_dollar(suffix = "B"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.15))) +
      labs(x = "Mandatory program", y = "Change ($ billions)", subtitle = paste0("Change in budget authority, FY", input$years[1], " → FY", input$years[2])) +
      theme_va() + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = muted, size = 8.5))
    p1
  }, res = 96)
  output$p_waffle <- renderPlot({
    g <- growth() |> arrange(desc(change)) |> mutate(program = factor(program, levels = program))
    raw <- 100 * pmax(g$share, 0); cents <- floor(raw); left <- 100 - sum(cents)
    if (left > 0) { o <- order(raw - floor(raw), decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(left)]; cents[o] <- cents[o] + 1 }
    w <- tibble(program = g$program, dollars = cents) |> tidyr::crossing(cell = 1:100) |>
      mutate(col = (cell - 1) %% 10, row = (cell - 1) %/% 10, fill = ifelse(cell <= dollars, as.character(program), "empty"))
    p2 <- ggplot(w, aes(col, row, colour = fill)) +
      geom_point(size = 2.25) +
      geom_text(data = distinct(w, program, dollars), aes(x = 4.5, y = 11.8, label = paste0("$", dollars)),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3, fontface = "bold", colour = ink) +
      facet_wrap(~program, nrow = 1, labeller = label_wrap_gen(14), strip.position = "bottom") +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(prog_cols, empty = "#E3E7EC"), guide = "none") +
      coord_equal(clip = "off") +
      labs(subtitle = "Of every $100 added", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
      theme_void(base_size = 8.5) + theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = ink, size = 8.5, margin = margin(t = 4)),
                                          panel.spacing.x = unit(4, "lines"), plot.margin = margin(0, 10, 4, 10),
                                          plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = muted, size = 8.5, margin = margin(b = 4)))
    p2
  }, res = 96)
  output$t_contrib <- renderUI({
    g <- growth() |> arrange(desc(change))
    p(HTML(paste0("From FY", input$years[1], " to FY", input$years[2], ", mandatory funding changed by <b>",
      bn(sum(g$change)), "</b>: ",
      paste0("<b>", g$program, "</b> ", ifelse(g$change >= 0, "+", "−"), bn(abs(g$change)), " (", pct(g$share), ")", collapse = "; "), ".")))
  })

  # ---- index + share
  output$p_share <- renderPlot({
    f <- first()
    full <- r2() |> transmute(fiscal_year, Mandatory = 100 * mandatory / f$mandatory, Discretionary = 100 * discretionary / f$discretionary)
    ylim_idx <- range(c(100, full$Mandatory, full$Discretionary))
    d <- r2() |> transmute(fiscal_year, Mandatory = 100 * mandatory / f$mandatory, Discretionary = 100 * discretionary / f$discretionary,
                           share = discretionary / total)
    di <- d |> select(-share) |> pivot_longer(-fiscal_year)
    p1 <- ggplot(di, aes(fiscal_year, value, colour = name)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 100, colour = "#9AA5B4") +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.4) +
      geom_point(data = di |> filter(fiscal_year == max(fiscal_year)), size = 2.4) +
      geom_text(data = di |> filter(fiscal_year == max(fiscal_year)), aes(label = name),
                hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.3, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = ylim_idx) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(Mandatory = pal[["purple"]], Discretionary = pal[["blue"]]), guide = "none") +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = function(l) { b <- pretty(input$years, 4); b[b >= input$years[1] & b <= input$years[2]] },
                         expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.45))) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      labs(subtitle = "Growth since the first year", x = "Fiscal year", y = paste0("Index (FY", input$years[1], " = 100)")) +
      theme_va() + theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = muted, size = 8.5))
    p2 <- ggplot(d, aes(fiscal_year, share)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.4, colour = pal[["pink"]]) +
      geom_point(data = d |> filter(fiscal_year %in% range(fiscal_year)), size = 3, colour = pal[["pink"]]) +
      geom_text(data = d |> filter(fiscal_year %in% range(fiscal_year)), aes(label = pct(share)),
                vjust = -1, size = 3, colour = ink) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 0.65)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(4), limits = input$years) +
      labs(subtitle = "Discretionary ÷ total VA funding", x = "Fiscal year", y = "Discretionary share (%)") +
      theme_va() + theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = muted, size = 8.5))
    if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, ncol = 2) else p1
  }, res = 96)
  output$t_share <- renderUI({
    f <- first(); l <- last()
    cf <- l$discretionary / (l$discretionary + f$mandatory * l$discretionary / f$discretionary)
    p(HTML(paste0("Discretionary funding grew <b>", formatC(l$discretionary / f$discretionary, format = "f", digits = 1),
      "×</b> while mandatory grew <b>", formatC(l$mandatory / f$mandatory, format = "f", digits = 1), "×</b>. ",
      "Had mandatory grown at the discretionary pace, the discretionary share would be ", pct(cf), " instead of ",
      pct(l$discretionary / l$total), ", so the shrinking share is ",
      if (l$mandatory / f$mandatory > l$discretionary / f$discretionary) "a <b>denominator effect</b>." else "not driven by mandatory growth in this window.")))
  })
}
```

# Map · Where VA spends

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 1350
## file: app.R
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- data (read and joined once)
# GDX expenditures by state and fiscal year ($000s), built by va_map_data.R
va <- read.csv("va_states.csv") |>
  mutate(con_share = if_else(state == "District of Columbia", NA_real_,
                             100 * construction / total_ex_loan))
# Census state boundaries (us-atlas, 1:10m), simplified, EPSG:4326
states <- st_read("us_states.geojson", quiet = TRUE) |> st_transform(4326)
va_sf  <- states |> inner_join(va, by = "state")            # one row per state x year

VARS <- c("Compensation & pension share (% of state VA spending)" = "cp_share",
          "Medical care per unique patient ($)"                  = "med_per_pt",
          "Construction share (% of state VA spending)"          = "con_share")
UNIT <- c(cp_share = "%", med_per_pt = "$", con_share = "%")
FY_MIN <- min(va$fiscal_year); FY_MAX <- max(va$fiscal_year)

# national value of each measure (states, PR and Guam; DC left out as in the map)
national <- va |> filter(state != "District of Columbia") |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(cp_share   = 100 * sum(comp_pension) / sum(total_ex_loan),
            med_per_pt = 1000 * sum(medical_care) / sum(unique_patients),
            con_share  = 100 * sum(construction) / sum(total_ex_loan), .groups = "drop")

fmt <- function(x, var) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "not comparable",
         if (UNIT[[var]] == "$") paste0("$", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","))
         else paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 1), "%"))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- look
ink <- "#13233F"; muted <- "#5A6578"; navy <- "#0A1F44"; red <- "#B31942"
src_note <- "Source: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Geographic Distribution of VA Expenditures (GDX), FY2015–FY2023; boundaries: U.S. Census Bureau (us-atlas). Loan Guaranty excluded; DC not comparable (includes VA Central Office)."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- UI
ui <- page_sidebar(
  fillable = FALSE,
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5, primary = "#0A3161", base_font = font_google("Source Sans 3", local = FALSE),
                   heading_font = font_google("Oswald", local = FALSE), fg = ink, bg = "#ffffff"),
  sidebar = sidebar(
    width = 290,
    selectInput("var", "Measure", choices = VARS),
    sliderInput("year", "Fiscal year", min = FY_MIN, max = FY_MAX, value = FY_MAX, step = 1, sep = ""),
    radioButtons("style", "Colour scale",
                 c("Quantile (5 classes)" = "quantile", "Continuous" = "continuous")),
    helpText("GDX advises against dividing compensation, pension or total spending by the veteran population, so the map shows shares of each state's VA spending and medical care per patient.")
  ),
  tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
    .bslib-value-box { min-height: 0 !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .card-body { padding: .3rem .4rem !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-area { padding: .35rem .8rem !important; gap: 0 !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-title { font-size: .85rem !important; margin-bottom: .1rem !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-value { font-size: 1.55rem !important; line-height: 1.15 !important; margin-bottom: .1rem !important; }
    .bslib-sidebar-layout > .sidebar { font-size: .9rem; }
    .bslib-sidebar-layout > .sidebar .control-label, .bslib-sidebar-layout > .sidebar .form-label { font-size: .9rem; }
    .vb-row { margin-bottom: 1.4rem !important; }
    .vb-row + * { margin-top: 0 !important; }
    .bslib-value-box { border: 0 !important; border-top: 4px solid #B31942 !important; border-radius: 6px !important; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-title { font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-title::before { content: '\\2605  '; color: #B31942; }
    .bslib-value-box .value-box-value { font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; font-weight: 600 !important; letter-spacing: .02em; }
    .card-header { font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #0A1F44; border-bottom: 2px solid #B31942; }
    .card-footer .src { font-size: .75rem; color: #5A6578; margin-top: .35rem; border-top: 1px solid #E3E7EC; padding-top: .3rem; }
    .bslib-value-box p { font-size: .8rem !important; margin: 0 !important; opacity: .9; }
    .leaflet-container { background: #F4F5F7; }
    .info.legend { font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; }
  "))),
  layout_columns(
    fill = FALSE, class = "vb-row",
    value_box(title = "States shown", value = textOutput("vb_n"),
              theme = value_box_theme(bg = navy, fg = "white"), p(textOutput("vb_n_note"))),
    value_box(title = "Median state", value = textOutput("vb_med"),
              theme = value_box_theme(bg = navy, fg = "white"), p(textOutput("vb_med_note"))),
    value_box(title = "National value", value = textOutput("vb_nat"),
              theme = value_box_theme(bg = navy, fg = "white"), p(textOutput("vb_nat_note")))
  ),
  card(full_screen = TRUE,
       card_header(textOutput("map_ttl", inline = TRUE)),
       leafletOutput("map", height = "520px"),
       card_footer(uiOutput("map_txt"), div(class = "src", src_note))),
  card(full_screen = TRUE,
       card_header(textOutput("top_ttl", inline = TRUE)),
       plotOutput("top10", height = "330px"),
       card_footer(div(class = "src", src_note)))
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- server
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # one shared reactive: the sf data for the chosen year and measure
  dat <- reactive({
    d <- va_sf |> filter(fiscal_year == input$year)
    d$value <- d[[input$var]]
    d
  })
  var_label <- reactive(names(VARS)[VARS == input$var])
  nat_value <- reactive(national[[input$var]][national$fiscal_year == input$year])

  # ---- value boxes
  output$vb_n <- renderText(sum(!is.na(dat()$value)))
  output$vb_n_note <- renderText(paste0("with data in FY", input$year, "; DC shown as not comparable"))
  output$vb_med <- renderText(fmt(median(dat()$value, na.rm = TRUE), input$var))
  output$vb_med_note <- renderText({
    d <- st_drop_geometry(dat()) |> filter(!is.na(value))
    hi <- d$state[which.max(d$value)]; lo <- d$state[which.min(d$value)]
    paste0("highest: ", hi, "; lowest: ", lo)
  })
  output$vb_nat <- renderText(fmt(nat_value(), input$var))
  output$vb_nat_note <- renderText(paste0("all states, PR and Guam pooled, FY", input$year))

  # ---- map: base map once, polygons redrawn with leafletProxy()
  output$map <- renderLeaflet(
    leaflet(options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 2, zoomSnap = 0.25)) |>
      addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") |>   # no API key needed
      setView(-104, 41, zoom = 3.25))

  observe({
    d <- dat()
    v <- d$value
    pal <- if (input$style == "quantile") {
      br <- unique(quantile(v, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE))
      colorBin("Blues", domain = v, bins = br, na.color = "#d9d9d9", right = FALSE)
    } else {
      colorNumeric("Blues", domain = v, na.color = "#d9d9d9")
    }
    lab_fmt <- if (UNIT[[input$var]] == "$") labelFormat(prefix = "$", big.mark = ",", digits = 0)
               else labelFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 1)
    labels <- sprintf("<strong>%s</strong><br/>%s: %s<br/>FY%s", d$state, var_label(),
                      fmt(v, input$var), input$year) |> lapply(HTML)
    leafletProxy("map", data = d) |>
      clearShapes() |> clearControls() |>
      addPolygons(fillColor = ~pal(value), fillOpacity = 0.85, weight = 0.6, color = "white",
                  label = labels,
                  highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = red, bringToFront = TRUE)) |>
      addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~value, title = var_label(), labFormat = lab_fmt,
                na.label = "Not comparable (DC)", position = "topright", opacity = 0.85)
  })

  # ---- message titles and text (update with the inputs)
  output$map_ttl <- renderText({
    d <- st_drop_geometry(dat()) |> filter(!is.na(value)) |> arrange(desc(value))
    paste0(var_label(), ", FY", input$year, ": highest in ", paste(head(d$state, 3), collapse = ", "))
  })
  output$map_txt <- renderUI({
    first <- national[[input$var]][national$fiscal_year == FY_MIN]
    p(HTML(paste0("Nationally the measure moved from <b>", fmt(first, input$var), "</b> in FY", FY_MIN,
                  " to <b>", fmt(nat_value(), input$var), "</b> in FY", input$year,
                  ". Hover over a state for its value. ",
                  if (input$style == "quantile") "Each colour holds about a fifth of the states." else
                    "Colours are proportional to the value.")))
  })
  output$top_ttl <- renderText(paste0("Top 10 states on the selected measure, FY", input$year))

  # ---- companion chart: top 10 states, with the national value marked
  output$top10 <- renderPlot({
    d <- st_drop_geometry(dat()) |> filter(!is.na(value)) |> slice_max(value, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)
    lab <- function(x) fmt(x, input$var)
    ggplot(d, aes(value, reorder(state, value))) +
      geom_col(fill = "#0A3161", width = 0.7) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = nat_value(), colour = red, linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
      annotate("text", x = nat_value(), y = 10.45, label = " national", hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
               colour = red, size = 3.6, fontface = "bold") +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      geom_text(aes(label = lab(value)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.4, colour = ink) +
      scale_x_continuous(labels = lab, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
      labs(x = var_label(), y = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      theme(text = element_text(colour = ink), axis.text = element_text(colour = muted),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
